revision_summary: Three quote/timestamp mismatches need correction in script_coverage: (1) the bill_collection customer_quote 'Alright. I just got billed to' is mistimed at 03:30 — it actually occurs at 06:09 (and bill_document_audit already has this correct, creating an internal contradiction Stage 3 should reconcile); (2) the appointment_set section's rep quote 'So we got you for 2PM, on March 18' is mistimed at 06:29 — that confirmation actually happens around 08:09-08:15, with 06:29 being where the rep first asks about scheduling ('what's a good week for you guys?'); (3) the appointment_set customer_quote 'About Wednesday' is mistimed at 06:29 — it occurs at 07:26-07:29. Stage 3 should split the appointment_set script_coverage entry into its natural sub-beats (initial ask ~06:29, day confirmation ~07:26, time confirmation ~08:01-08:15) with correct timestamps for each quote rather than collapsing them under one mistimed anchor. Additionally: reclassify the 04:35 daughter's-bill-name moment away from 'knowledge_gap' (wrong schema category — that's for rep not knowing an answer) to something like 'unprobed_account_detail' and soften the handoff_brief language that frames it as an 'ownership/account-holder status unclear' financing concern, since the transcript only shows a passing aside, not a substantiated open issue. Also reconsider the cherry_pick_moments[5] classification label 'setter_scope_creep' for the 08:43 'No way.' entry, since the entry's own analysis concludes no scope creep occurred — the classification tag contradicts the write-up. Finally, consider adding a cherry_pick_moment for the 08:44 price-ballpark question ('When he had discussed... how much it'll be') scored against rebuttals.price_estimate_before_design, which was a real, schema-relevant moment left out.
